description: This file defines the ListView class used for rendering list views in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for processing list data, handling pagination, sorting, template assignment, and security checks, tailored for displaying collections of objects within the CRM framework.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views, managing pagination, sorting, security, and template rendering in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: setDataArray
methods.description: Sets the data array for the list view to be processed and displayed.

methods.name: processListViewMulti
methods.description: Processes and outputs a multi-select list view, including mass update controls.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Main method to process and display a list view, handling data fetching, security, and template rendering.

methods.name: process_dynamic_listview
methods.description: Handles dynamic list view rendering, including header and row processing.

methods.name: process_dynamic_listview_rows
methods.description: Internal method that processes each row of a dynamic list view, assigning fields and handling security permissions.

methods.name: setDisplayHeaderAndFooter
methods.description: Controls whether to display the header and footer in the list view.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes ListView properties, such as records per page and theme-related settings.

methods.name: setRecordsPerPage
methods.description: Sets the number of records to display per page.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets additional header text for the list view, often containing buttons or info.

methods.name: setXTemplatePath
methods.description: Sets the path for the XTemplate file used to render the list view.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new XTemplate object for rendering.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Retrieves and sets the order by clause based on session, request, and defaults.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets query parameters such as where clause, limit, and order by for data fetching.

methods.name: displayArrow
methods.description: Empty placeholder, potentially for future arrow indicator logic.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the current theme and updates the template accordingly.

methods.name: setAppStrings
methods.description: Sets application-wide language strings for localization.

methods.name: setModStrings
methods.description: Sets module-specific language strings.

methods.name: setImagePath
methods.description: Sets the image path for theme images and updates the template.

methods.name: setCurrentModule
methods.description: Sets the current module context and updates the template.

methods.name: createXTemplate
methods.description: Creates an XTemplate object based on the defined template path.

methods.name: setXTemplate
methods.description: Assigns an external XTemplate object to the ListView for rendering.

methods.name: getXTemplate
methods.description: Returns the current XTemplate object used for rendering.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns a variable to the XTemplate.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the current offset for pagination, resetting if query has changed.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the current data offset for pagination.

methods.name: setSessionVariable
methods.description: Stores a variable in the PHP session.

methods.name: setUserVariable
methods.description: Stores a user preference variable.

methods.name: getSessionVariable
methods.description: Retrieves a variable from the session, checking request parameters first.

methods.name: getUserVariable
methods.description: Retrieves a user preference variable.

methods.name: calculateSortOrder
methods.description: Determines sort order ('asc' or 'desc') based on priority sources.

methods.name: getSessionVariableName
methods.description: Builds a session variable name with context of module and list view element.

methods.name: processSugarBean
methods.description: Processes a SugarBean seed to generate list data, including security and pagination.

methods.name: processUnionBeans
methods.description: Fetches and processes a union of related list beans, handling sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getBaseURL
methods.description: Constructs base URL for list navigation links, including request parameters.

methods.name: processListNavigation
methods.description: Handles rendering of pagination controls and navigation links in list views.
